player.description: Who is resuming; must equal the envelope from.

logHash.description: Hash of the last log entry this participant holds; 64 zeros when it holds none.

signature.description: The participant's signature over canonicalJson({matchId, player, logHash, logLength}) with its roster key.

description: client -> host. First frame on a new socket to the current host, after a drop or a host transfer; never a fresh HELLO.
